coverage.summary: Applies to the sale or rental of all real property. Limited exemptions cover owner-occupied two-family dwellings, rooms rented in an owner- or occupant-occupied one-family home, religious-organization preference, housing for older persons (familial status only) and single-sex residences.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt: (1) rental of a single apartment in a two-family dwelling whose other unit is occupied by the owner as a residence at the time of rental; (2) rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied as his/her residence at the time of rental.

result.notes: I moved the owner/occupant-occupied one-family room rental exemption from unverifiable_exemptions into owner_conditions, because it turns on owner occupancy and building type, both of which are verifiable facts. I split the combined single-sex/older-persons item into two entries. D068 limits the older-persons exemption to familial status. The single-sex exemption is supported only by D067, which phrases it ambiguously alongside age-restricted housing and familial status. I left requires_unknown_facts null because no passage directly supports it.
